title: Corpus mapping: pinned repos -> tools/languages + gap register

checks.name: at least the 29 pinned repositories enumerated
gap register flags thin coverage (<50 files)
unknown-extension files are recorded (not silently dropped)
no language outside the 41 is silently mapped
unsupported language (.mojo) is not mapped to a supported analyzer [negative]
at least 40 of 41 languages have at least one corpus file

decisions.detection: file-extension mapping (honest proxy; actual analyzer coverage is measured per analyzer issue)
decisions.honesty: unknown-extension files and unsupported languages are recorded, never silently mapped
decisions.thresholds: zero coverage = 0 files; thin coverage = 1..49 files

limitations: Extension mapping approximates language presence; it does not prove an analyzer parses those files correctly.
Downloading gap-closing repos is a follow-on action; this issue records the gap register and recommendations.
